extracted.name: Pumpkin Spice Chai Latte
extracted.description: Pumpkin spice chai latte is a delicious twist on the classic chai latte, infused with warm and comforting flavors perfect for the fall season. It's a lovely drink to enjoy on a crisp autumn day, wrapped in a cozy sweater and surrounded by the comforting aroma of fall spices.
ingredient_lines: Add the pumpkin spice, cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, nutmeg, dry ginger all together and keep aside. This is you pumpkin spice chai mixture
instruction_lines: Steep the teabags in hot milk and prepare unsweetened tea. Add this tea to a small pot.
Next, add the pumpkin puree to the pot.
Next, add the honey/ maple syrup.
After that add the pumpkin spice chai mixture.
Stir and heat on low for 5 minutes, so the rawness of the pumpkin purée goes away and the spices are blended well.
When the mixture is heated through, pour in a tall glass, add some whipped cream and a sprinkling of cinnamon and enjoy!
